mechanisms.title: 保留失败因果链，并把退化成功归类为可重试的边界错误
mechanisms.problem: 诊断边界一旦把下层错误压成消息字符串、单一错误码或空成功，调用方就失去分类与恢复依据；传输截断、空响应、未知停止原因、同一轮重试后的终态错误和空子代理输出都会被静默吞掉。
triggers: 适配器、传输层、工具执行器或 UI 需要把一个下层失败转换成自己的错误
模型返回空内容、被截断的流或未知停止原因
同一 turn 内发生重试，需要保留终态错误行
子代理的 terminal message 没有内容块，仍要选出 canonical output
obligations: 在诊断边界保留原始错误或 Error.cause 链；只有拿到证据时才合并分类
把已识别的中途断连与终止事件前流截断归类为 TRANSPORT，由已组合的 llm-retry 默认策略有界重试；不能把未分类 PI_AI_ERROR 整桶改成可重试
只有 `stop` finish 且零 content blocks 的 completed 响应才视为 provider 边界的可重试错误；重试耗尽后 fail turn；whitespace-only 与 reasoning-only 仍算成功
TUI 必须为每个非 completed 的 turn/end 显示停止原因；completed 由最终 assistant message 与 Completed timing header 表示；未知插件 kind 也要按名称显示，不能留白
同一 turn 重试后仍保留终态错误行，不得让后续成功覆盖历史

子代理输出按确定性规则选择：取最后一条非空 Assistant message；没有则取 embedded `assistant/message`/`assistant/attempt` 流或 chunk-only transport 累积的 `text-delta`；忽略空 content message。两种形式都不存在时 lifecycle 字段 absent，而不是空数组或显式错误；`max-tokens`/`aborted` 保留真实 stop reason
steps: 在捕获点保存 original error、cause、code 和传输元数据，先不重写 message
在分类点只按可证明的字段划分 retryable/truncated/empty/provider/terminal
为每个非 completed 的 turn/end 生成可见 reason；completed 由 assistant message/timing header 表示；为每次重试保留前后错误事实
按「最后非空 Assistant message → 累积 text-delta」顺序选择子代理输出；两种形式都不存在时让 lifecycle 字段 absent

implementation: 诊断边界保留可获得的 cause 链；pi-ai 已压平而不可恢复的 cause 明确披露，只对来源列出的传输消息做 best-effort TRANSPORT 分类
分类测试覆盖截断、空完成、未知停止原因和同轮重试四个分支
UI 快照/断言要求每个非 completed turn/end 的 reason 可见；completed 保持静默；未知 kind 按名称显示
enforcement.trust: Reviewer trusts cause-chain/classification tests; provider-specific behavior must be re-verified per version.
enforcement.failure: Dropping an available cause chain, treating recognized transport truncation as permanent, or widening all PI_AI_ERROR failures to retryable blocks the change; flattened upstream detail must not be invented.
exceptions: Provider-specific error classes may differ; classify only with evidence.

pi-ai 0.81.1 exposes no hook that preserves the lost mid-stream cause; message matching is the documented adapter workaround until upstream forwards code/cause, not a universal classifier or UI heuristic.
TUI completed turns stay silent by design; unknown plugin kinds must be named, not mapped to completed.

Empty-response detection covers only `stop` finishes with zero content blocks; whitespace-only and reasoning-only responses stay successful, and no provider-semantic whitelist exists. A genuinely empty reply is retried and then fails the turn — an accepted trade-off because it is indistinguishable from the provider defect.
